qe: In “सुंदर फूल खिला”, which word is the adjective?
qh: “सुंदर फूल खिला” वाक्य में विशेषण कौन-सा है?
e: “सुंदर” describes the noun “फूल”.

qe: In “वह धीरे चलता है”, which word is an adverb?
qh: “वह धीरे चलता है” में क्रिया-विशेषण कौन-सा है?
e: “धीरे” tells how he walks.

qe: Which punctuation mark normally ends a direct question?
qh: सीधे प्रश्न के अंत में सामान्यतः कौन-सा विराम-चिह्न लगाया जाता है?
e: A direct question ends with a question mark.

qe: What is the prefix in the Hindi word “असफल”?
qh: “असफल” शब्द में उपसर्ग कौन-सा है?
e: “अ-” is added before “सफल” to give the opposite sense.

qe: Choose the correct article: It took ___ hour to reach the station.
qh: स्टेशन पहुँचने में ___ घंटा लगा। अंग्रेज़ी वाक्य में सही article चुनें।
e: “Hour” begins with a vowel sound, so use “an”.

qe: Choose the passive form: “The guard opened the gate.”
qh: “चौकीदार ने फाटक खोला।” इसका सही English passive रूप चुनें।
oe: The guard was opened by the gate.
The gate was opened by the guard.
The gate is opening the guard.
oh: The guard was opened by the gate.
The gate was opened by the guard.
The gate is opening the guard.
e: The object becomes the subject: “The gate was opened…”

qe: Change to indirect speech: He said, “I am tired.”
qh: उसने कहा, “मैं थका हूँ।” इसे English में indirect speech में कैसे लिखेंगे?
oe: He said that I am tired.
He said that he was tired.
oh: He said that I am tired.
He said that he was tired.
e: In reported speech, “am” changes to “was” after “said”.

qe: Solve for x: 3x + 5 = 20.
qh: x का मान ज्ञात करें: 3x + 5 = 20।
e: Subtract 5 from both sides to get 3x = 15, so x = 5.

qe: Find the area of a trapezium with parallel sides 12 cm and 8 cm and height 5 cm.
qh: समांतर भुजाएँ 12 सेमी और 8 सेमी तथा ऊँचाई 5 सेमी वाले समलंब का क्षेत्रफल क्या है?
e: Area = ½(a+b)h = ½(20)(5) = 50 cm².

qe: What is the square root of 2,025?
qh: 2,025 का वर्गमूल क्या है?

qe: Five notebooks cost ₹75. At the same rate, what do 8 notebooks cost?
qh: 5 कॉपियों का मूल्य ₹75 है। उसी दर से 8 कॉपियों का मूल्य कितना होगा?
e: One notebook costs ₹15, so 8 cost ₹120.

qe: A is the father of B. B is the sister of C. How is A related to C?
qh: A, B का पिता है और B, C की बहन है। A का C से क्या संबंध है?
e: B and C are siblings, so their father A is also C’s father.

qe: What is the smaller angle between clock hands at exactly 3:00?
qh: ठीक 3:00 बजे घड़ी की सुइयों के बीच छोटा कोण कितना होता है?
e: At 3:00, the hands are three hour marks apart: 3×30° = 90°.

qe: Sujni embroidery is a traditional craft associated with which Bihar area?
qh: सुजनी कढ़ाई बिहार के किस क्षेत्र की पारंपरिक कला है?
e: Sujni embroidery is associated with Bhusura village in Muzaffarpur.

qe: Tikuli painting is especially associated with which city?
qh: टिकुली चित्रकला किस शहर से विशेष रूप से जुड़ी है?
e: Patna is an important centre of Tikuli art.

qe: Sikki grass craft is traditionally practised in which Bihar cultural region?
qh: सिक्की घास शिल्प बिहार के किस सांस्कृतिक क्षेत्र में प्रचलित है?
e: Sikki craft is strongly associated with the Mithila region.

qe: Which bird is recognised as Bihar’s state bird?
qh: बिहार का राज्य पक्षी कौन-सा है?
e: The house sparrow is the state bird of Bihar.

qe: Which animal is recognised as Bihar’s state animal?
qh: बिहार का राज्य पशु कौन-सा है?
e: The gaur is recognised as Bihar’s state animal.

qe: Who appoints the Governor of an Indian state?
qh: भारतीय राज्य के राज्यपाल की नियुक्ति कौन करता है?
e: The President appoints each state Governor.

qe: The Equator divides Earth into which two halves?
qh: भूमध्य रेखा पृथ्वी को किन दो भागों में बाँटती है?
e: The Equator separates the Northern and Southern Hemispheres.

qe: Which layer is the solid outer surface of Earth on which continents lie?
qh: पृथ्वी की वह ठोस बाहरी परत कौन-सी है जिस पर महाद्वीप स्थित हैं?
e: The crust is Earth’s thin, solid outer layer.

qe: Which process allows rainwater to enter the soil from the ground surface?
qh: वर्षा का पानी जमीन की सतह से मिट्टी में प्रवेश करने की प्रक्रिया क्या कहलाती है?
e: Infiltration is the process by which water enters the soil from the surface.

qe: A person who sells goods directly to consumers is part of which activity?
qh: जो व्यक्ति वस्तुएँ सीधे उपभोक्ताओं को बेचता है, वह किस गतिविधि में काम करता है?
e: Retail trade sells goods to final consumers.

qe: Wind-dispersed seeds commonly have which feature?
qh: हवा से फैलने वाले बीजों में सामान्यतः कौन-सी विशेषता होती है?
e: Light or wing-like parts help seeds travel with wind.

qe: In a simple food chain, green plants are called:
qh: सरल खाद्य-श्रृंखला में हरे पौधे क्या कहलाते हैं?
e: Plants make their own food and form the producer level.

qe: Friction acts in which direction relative to sliding motion?
qh: घर्षण फिसलने की गति की तुलना में किस दिशा में लगता है?
e: Friction opposes relative motion between surfaces.

qe: A fuse wire protects a circuit because it:
qh: फ्यूज तार परिपथ की रक्षा कैसे करता है?
oh: अधिक धारा बहने पर पिघल जाता है
e: Excess current heats and melts the fuse, breaking the circuit.

qe: Which organ filters many wastes from the blood to form urine?
qh: रक्त से कई अपशिष्ट छानकर मूत्र बनाने वाला अंग कौन-सा है?
e: Kidneys filter blood and help form urine.

qe: A magnet attracts which common material most strongly?
qh: चुंबक सामान्यतः किस पदार्थ को सबसे अधिक आकर्षित करता है?
e: Iron is a strongly magnetic material.

qe: Brass is an alloy made mainly from which two metals?
qh: पीतल मुख्यतः किन दो धातुओं की मिश्रधातु है?
e: Brass is mainly an alloy of copper and zinc.
